results.title: Payroll Tax Threshold VIC 2026–27: Rates & Who Pays
results.description:
# Payroll Tax Threshold VIC 2026–27: Rates & Who Pays
The payroll tax threshold in Victoria for 2026–27 is $1 million a year, or $83,333 a month, unchanged from 2025–26. The standard VIC payroll tax rate is 4.85%. The threshold works as a deduction, not an exemption: your first $1 million of Australian wages stays tax-free, and the rate applies only to wages above it.

Below, we cover the current payroll tax thresholds, who has to register, and the grouping rules that quietly strip the deduction from growing Melbourne businesses.

## What Is the Victorian Payroll Tax Threshold?
The Victorian payroll tax threshold is the tax-free amount deducted from those wages before the 4.85% rate is applied. For 2026–27, the full deduction is worth $1 million.

A Melbourne business paying $1.2 million in annual wages, all in Victoria, deducts the $1 million threshold and pays 4.85% on the remaining $200,000. The bill comes to $9,700 for the year. Wages under the threshold stay tax-free even once you’re over it. Only the excess gets taxed.

Interstate wages and part-year employment both reduce your entitlement. The phase-out zone, covered below, can remove it altogether.

## Current VIC Payroll Tax Thresholds (2025–26 and 2026–27)
|  |  |  |  |
|-|-|-|-|
| **Financial year** | **Annual threshold** | **Monthly threshold** | **Standard rate** |
| 2026–27 | $1,000,000 | $83,333 | 4.85% |

Looking back slightly further, the Victoria payroll tax threshold sat at $700,000 as recently as 2023–24. The VIC payroll tax threshold now sits $300,000 higher than it did two years ago, which pulled thousands of smaller employers out of the system entirely.

## Where This Usually Lands
The threshold is one number.

## FAQs
### [What is the payroll tax threshold in Victoria?](https://bookkeepingandpayroll.com.au/payroll-tax-threshold-vic-2026-27-rates-who-pays/#)
For 2026–27, the payroll tax threshold Victoria sets is $1 million a year, or $83,333 a month. The figure is a deduction from taxable wages, and several things reduce it, most commonly interstate wages and the $3 million to $5 million phase-out.

### [How much is payroll tax in Victoria?](https://bookkeepingandpayroll.com.au/payroll-tax-threshold-vic-2026-27-rates-who-pays/#)
The standard rate is 4.85% of taxable wages above the deduction, with eligible regional employers on 1.2125%.

### [Who pays payroll tax in Victoria?](https://bookkeepingandpayroll.com.au/payroll-tax-threshold-vic-2026-27-rates-who-pays/#)
Employers whose total Australian wages, grouped entities included, exceed the threshold.
